Reserve sizing folds the pending OG share in at `genesisPending` CauldronRegistry.sol:1001, clamps three ways at `newActive` CauldronRegistry.sol:1016, CauldronRegistry.sol:1043 and CauldronRegistry.sol:1056, and only then splits supply at `newReserve` CauldronRegistry.sol:1057.
